arguments.content: Built KORE SQL engine beating Apache Spark 8x on TPC-H benchmarks. Chose performance over readability always. Rust is the right choice for data engines.
Decided to use zero-copy architecture for all data pipelines. Chose performance over safety in hot paths. Using unsafe Rust where benchmarks justify it.
Rejected microservices for KORE. Chose monolith architecture for the core engine. Single binary is the right choice for performance.

arguments.context: choosing between microservices and monolith for the next KORE module

arguments.prompt: How should we design the distributed layer of KORE?
